name: Travel Planner by Gildhart
changelog:
• The whole of a vaccine's card is now the way on, not only its name. Where the pharmacy has its own page about the vaccine, a tap anywhere on the card goes there, as the name does; where it has none, a tap on the card goes to the booking. A vaccine the pharmacy does not give goes nowhere. The same in country guides. Visitors were tapping the cards and nothing happened.
  • A card with no page adds no words: its vaccine's name stays plain text, and the link to the booking is named for a screen reader only ("Book a travel consultation (Rabies (pre-exposure))").
